name: A02_clip
prompt: 2D animated documentary scene, clean cel shading, bold outlines, flat muted earthy colors, consistent style in every frame. The two brown mules walk side by side from left to right in a steady walking rhythm, pulling the wooden wagon heaped with oak firewood; their legs move in a natural four-beat gait, hooves lifting and landing on the stones, heads nodding with each step, ears flicking, tails swishing. The big spoked iron-rimmed wagon wheel turns and rolls over the ruts. Puffs of dust rise from the hooves and the wheel and drift back in the sunlight. The golden grass at the road edge sways in a light breeze. The camera stays low and tracks slowly sideways alongside the team, keeping both mules and the wheel in frame. Calm mid-morning light.
